headlines.title: PayPal Survey Reveals Holiday Spending Isn't Slowing Down, But Shoppers Are Changing How They Spend
headlines.summary: Holiday shoppers aren't necessarily spending less this year. They're changing how they spend. PayPal today released its 2026 Holiday Shopping Survey, revealing that nearly six in 10 Americans (58%) feel greater financial concern heading into the holidays, yet 64% still expect to spend the same or more than they did last holiday season. Faced with that tension, shoppers are planning earlier, setting budgets and looking for more ways to get value from every purchase.

headlines.title: PayPal (PYPL) Stock Looks Reasonable Based On Current Earnings
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings has seen its share price fall sharply over the past few years, even as new partnerships put the company back in the headlines. With the stock around US$53.89, the question for investors is whether that price is adequately backed by the earnings the business is generating today. PayPal shares have declined 79.4% over the past 5 years, which puts the focus squarely on whether the current earnings profile supports where the stock now trades.

headlines.title: Why Is PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Tightening Fraud Controls Across Its Payments Network?
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) is now integrated with IPQualityScore within platforms such as Alloy, Shopify, and Stripe. The IPQS connection feeds fraud intelligence and digital risk signals directly into PayPal transaction and account workflows for participating merchants. The expanded integration is expected to affect customer onboarding checks, security event handling, and fraud detection rules used across the PayPal ecosystem.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
